selection_rule: largest eligible model/prompt segment, earliest evaluation per related group, hash-order first 20 groups in each recorded decision stratum
selection_warning: These are sampling strata, not human labels; this balanced diagnostic sample is not a production-rate estimate.
heldout_status: reserved cohort; snapshot and partition will be created only after human labels are frozen
exclusion_policy: no replacements; at least 10 retained groups per recorded-prediction stratum and both human classes overall
